title: Fincons's Flowable row establishes only 1,700-plus staff and system-integrator positioning
content:
The Fincons Group row contains one fact and one label: 1,700-plus staff, system integrator. Its geography — Milan plus Switzerland, Germany, France, the UK and the US — comes from the lead record rather than from the research text. There is no assessment of practice depth, vertical focus or open-source posture.

On the criteria the screen applies elsewhere, the single fact present is enough to explain the priority 3 filing and nothing more. At that headcount the sale is an enterprise one, the same bracket as ELCA, GFT and Nortal in the same sweep. It is not enough to say whether the Flowable practice is a committed capability or one alliance among many, which is the distinction that separates Creetion from the rest of the cohort.

Recording the gap explicitly is the point: this row should not be read as a judgement that Fincons is a poor fit, only that scale is the only thing known about it. Provenance is the Flowable Partner Finder mined on 2026-08-18, not imprint-swept.
